newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates close up on routine payments.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates close up on routine payments.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates finished higher on Wednesday as continuous early-month payments tightened liquidity in the banking system, dealers said.
The overnight interbank rate ended at 4.971 percent against Tuesday's 4.859 close, with 30-day commercial paper at 4.90-5.00 against 4.80-4.95.
Dealers said they expected the interbank rate to rise further and to breach the 5.00 level on Thursday.
The bond market saw listless afternoon trade due to an absence of significant market-moving news, traders said.
